APAC.basis: India Copyright Act 1957 section 22: published literary works ordinarily run for the author's life plus 60 years.

USA.basis: The work was published as a book in 1929; the controlled source is a public-domain text repository.

UK.basis: The standard literary-work term is 70 years after the author's death; the recorded death year is 1950.

Europe.basis: The standard author-life-plus-70 framework is consistent with the recorded 1950 death year.
